title: Short Stirling W7467
memorial_details: Black granite tablet with incised inscription and names finished in gilt, set flush into a purpose-built brick wall. Coloured squadron badge at top of tablet. The whole memorial stands within an enclosed roadside corner plot.
inscription: On 17th January 1942 Stirling Aircraft W7467, of 7 Squadron, RAF, / flying from RAF Oakington, collided with a Hurricane Aircraft of No 56 OTU and crashed 1.5 miles north of Earith / All crew members were killed / (7 Names) / These received Christian Burials at Cambridge, Dundee and Thurrock / Walter Mankelow, RAFVR, Air-Gnr. and James McCarley, RAFVR, Air-Gnr. / are remembered on the Royal Air Force Memorial at Runnymede, / as having no known grave / The people of Earith, 7 Squadron Association and this Stone remember them / Per Diem Per Noctem / 7th November 1999
community_connection: The people of Earith, 7 Squadron Association and this Stone remember them
